# file-name

Require feature file names in a configured case style.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| naming | no | no | `{"style":"PascalCase"}` |

Requires file names in `PascalCase`, `Title Case`, `camelCase`, `kebab-case`, or `snake_case`, split into words as lodash does.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "file-name": ["error", {"style":"PascalCase"}] } }
```

## Triggered by

```text
checkout_flow.feature with PascalCase
```
